newsitem.title: USA: US Airways cuts U.S.-Canadian fares up to 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Airways cuts U.S.-Canadian fares up to 40 pct.

text.p: US Airways said Thursday that it has lowered U.S. and Canadian round-trip fares by as much as 40 percent.

Under the fare sale, the airline said tickets must be purchased at least 14-days prior to departure and no later than April 29, with travel completed by Oct. 8. Sale fares are nonrefundable and require one Saturday night stay.

The lowest fares, said the company, are available when traveling Tuesday through Thursday. When traveling to Florida, the lowest fares are available Sunday through Wednesday, and from Florida, Tuesday through Friday.
